text_block_list.name: Commentary
text_block_list.text:
The Tenno Sho (Spring) has arrived once 
more this year! Who will be the one to 
claim the glory of the Shield? Please wait 
just a little longer until post time—

text_block_list.name: Spectator A
text_block_list.text:
Ah, if only Oguri Cap and Super Creek were 
running in this race...

text_block_list.name: Spectator B
text_block_list.text:
There's no use dwelling on 'what-ifs'! 
It's already been announced that the two 
of them are resting for the first half of 
the season~.

text_block_list.name: Flat Cap-wearing Reporter
text_block_list.text:
—Inari One's spotlight still falls short 
compared to the likes of Oguri Cap, after 
all... huh?

text_block_list.name: Flat Cap-wearing Reporter
text_block_list.text:
"Still, this Tenno Sho (Spring) will 
surely show whether her resolve to become 
Umamusume of the Year is the real 
deal...!"

text_block_list.name: TV Audio
text_block_list.text:
“—Who will claim the glory of the Shield? 
Please stay tuned as we await post time—”

text_block_list.name: Downtown Man
text_block_list.text:
Ooh, here it comes! The 'Tenno Sho 
(Spring)' is about to start!! Go get 'em, 
Inari-chaaan!

text_block_list.name: Downtown Woman
text_block_list.text:
Haaah~ I'm getting nervous! Is Inari-chan 
gonna be okay? Did she eat properly, I 
wonder?

text_block_list.name: Umamusume with Purple Scrunchie
text_block_list.text:
"Woow~! Inari-neesan's name is really on 
the runner list...!"

text_block_list.name: Inari One
text_block_list.text:
—Guess that's the Tenno Sho (Spring) for 
ya. The sheer pressure from the crowd is 
hitting me way harder than anything I've 
felt before...

text_block_list.name: Inari One
text_block_list.text:
It's a shame Oguri and Creek had to pull 
out, but even so, none of the others are 
gonna be a walk in the park.

text_block_list.name: Inari One
text_block_list.text:
Gotta brace myself. If I half-ass it here, 
becoming Horse Girl of the Year is gonna 
stay nothing more than a pipe dream...!

text_block_list.name: Inari One
choice_data_list:
Try not to tense your shoulders too much, 
okay?

Try not to tense your shoulders too much, 
okay?

text_block_list.name: Inari One
text_block_list.text:
I know. I'll definitely... bring home 
results!
